turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on and, but and because?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Here are three linking words:
and - adds another idea
but - shows a difference
because - gives a reason
Example: She is happy because it is Friday.

Exercise 1. Join these two sentences with and:
I have a cat. I have a dog.
